source: 597 Too Dirty
target: 597 nimis sordidus

source: 597 Too Dirty
target: 597 nimis sordidus

source: Franca’s curiosity was piqued by Lumian’s words.
target: Curiositas Francae ex verbis Luminiani excitata est.

source: “Is there anything we can’t see?”
target: “Estne aliquid quod videre non possumus?”

source: “Are you sure you want to watch? I’m afraid it will deal a strong blow to your mind,” Lumian asked in a teasing tone.
target: “Certusne vis spectare? Metuo fore ut mens tua graviter percutiat,” inquit Lumian tono iocoso.

source: Amused, Franca pointed at herself and retorted, “Me? I’m not a minor. My mind is very mature. Why wouldn’t I dare to look? Heh, I’m much more knowledgeable than you, boy!”
target: Ludicriter, Franca se ipsam monstravit et respondit: “Ego? Non sum minor. Mens mea mature evoluta est. Cur non audeo aspicere? Eheu, multo magis eruditus sum quam tu, puer!”

source: Jenna nodded in agreement, silently endorsing Franca’s claim.
target: Jenna caput nutavit in consensu, tacite verba Francae confirmans.

source: Without further persuasion, Lumian left the apartment and headed to the room he had rented with a fake ID to monitor himself.
target: Sine ulteriore persuasione, Lumian habitationem reliquit et ad conclave quod cum identitate ficta conducerat ad se observandum se contulit.

source: Lugano was staying there with Ludwig.
target: Lugano ibi manebat cum Ludovico.

source: Franca followed with Jenna and Anthony, muttering, “I thought it was something major. Isn’t it just going to your godson? What impact on the mind…”
target: Franca cum Jenna et Antonio secuta est, murmure: “Putabam hoc esse rem maximi momenti. Nonne solum filio dei patroni tui destinatur? Quanta vim in mentem concutit…”

source: Lumian signaled for Lugano to retreat temporarily.
target: Lumian indicavit Lugano ut ad tempus recederet.

source: Then, he retrieved two gruesome items from his Traveler’s Bag, forming a humanoid figure with them.
target: Deinde duo horrenda res ex sacco viatoris sui extraxit, quibus imaginem humanam efficit.

source: Maintaining an unchanged expression, Lumian looked at Ludwig and pointed at the two parts of Mad Lady’s corpse.
target: Facie immutata servata, Lumian Ludovicum intuens duas partes cadaveris Dominae Insanae indicabat.

source: “Is it edible?”
target: “Estne edibilis?”

source: Edible… Franca was taken aback.
target: Edibilis… Franca stupens facta est.

source: Her gaze shifted between the repulsive corpse parts and Ludwig’s boyish appearance.
target: Conspectus eius inter partes cadaveris repugnantis et puerilem formam Ludovici vagabatur.

source: Suddenly, she felt a wave of nausea, as if her mind had been corrupted by the imagined scene.
target: Subito undam nausea sensit, quasi mens eius imaginata scena corrupta esset.

source: Indeed, Lumian’s godson gained knowledge or abilities by consuming specific creatures, including humans. Memory, after all, was a form of knowledge!
target: Vero, filius dei Luminiani scientiam aut facultates adipiscitur per devorandum certarum creaturarum, inter quas etiam homines erant. Memoria, postremo, erat genus scientiae!

source: Franca couldn’t suppress her urge to retch, regretting her decision to witness the cannibalistic act.
target: Franca impellitionem vomitus reprimere non potuit, de consilio suo actum cannibalisticum spectandi paenens.

source: To make matters worse, she knew the person who had been consumed—Mad Lady. She had interacted with her before.
target: Ad peius faciendum, scivit personam quae devorata fuerat—Domina Insana. Ea antea cum ea colloquium habuerat.

source: Jenna’s face contorted, clearly struggling to contain her churning stomach acid. Anthony, a seasoned veteran accustomed to witnessing scenes of gore, subconsciously frowned.
target: Vultus Jennae contortus erat, manifeste conans acidum ventris suum continere. Antonius, veteranus et solitus spectaculis cruentis spectare, subconscius fronem contraxit.

source: Ludwig scrutinized the two bloody corpse parts in Lumian’s hands for a moment before slowly shaking his head.
target: Ludwig duas partes cadaveris sanguinolentas in manibus Luminiani per breve tempus consideravit, deinde lente caput agitavit.

source: “It’s too dirty.”
target: “Nimis sordidum est.”

source: Dirty? Could it be a reference to the severe corruption of the Celestial Worthy? Even you won’t dare to swallow it for fear of something happening?
target: Sordidum? Num hoc refert ad gravem corruptionem Caelestium Dignitatum? Etiam tu non audes id deglutire ne quid eveniat?

source: Lumian threw Mad Lady’s two corpse parts to the ground with regret, summoning a crimson fireball that was nearly white.
target: Lumian duas partes cadaveris Dominae Insanae cum maerore in terram iecit, evocans globulum ignis rubri paene albi.

source: Rather than exploding, the fireball adhered to Mad Lady’s corpse, burning and compressing it into charred dust.
target: Pro his, globus ignis non explodivit, sed cadavero Dominae Insanae adhaesit, comburens et in pulverem carbonis compressum factus est.

source: Amidst the dancing flames and the burning fragrance, Franca and Jenna breathed a sigh of relief.
target: Inter flammas saltantes et odorem cremoris, Franca et Jenna leviter suspiraverunt.

source: Lumian pulled up a chair and sat down, addressing Ludwig, who was nonchalantly nibbling on a cupcake, “Wasn’t that person’s arm dirty?”
target: Lumian sellam trahevit et consedit, Ludovico loquens, qui placentam parvam non sollicite edebat, “Nonne brachium illius personae sordidum erat?”

source: He was referring to Loki.
target: Ad Loki referebat.

source: “Just a little. The dirtiest part isn’t on the arm,” Ludwig commented casually, as if discussing which fish were poisonous and how they should be consumed.
target: “Parum tantum. Maxime sordidum non est in brachio,” Ludwig leviter commentatus est, quasi de piscibus venenosis et modo edendi dissereret.

source: Only then did Lumian get to the point.
target: Tum demum Lumian ad rem pervenit.

source: “What did you gain from that person’s arm?”
target: “Quid ex illo brachchio adipiscutus es?”

source: “Some knowledge,” Ludwig replied, nonchalantly nibbling on a sponge cake covered in light cream, as if he preferred not to be disturbed while eating.
target: “Aliquam scientiam,” Ludwig respondit, non sollicitus, dum placentam spongiam in cremore leviter edebat, quasi non vellet interpellari dum comediret.

source: Lumian, feigning indifference, asked bluntly, “What are they?”
target: Lumian, imperturbabilitatem simulans, aperto interrogavit, “Quid sunt illa?”

source: Ludwig’s voice alternated between clarity and muffled tones as he replied, “Sequence Knowledge about his pathway… There are two other terms… One is Dylan… and the other is Orville…”
target: Vox Ludovici inter claritatem et attenuatos tonos alternabat, dum respondit, “Notitia sequentiae de via eius... Duo alii termini sunt... Unus est Dylan... et alter est Orville...”

source: Dylan? Is that the name of Loki’s ancient castle? And what’s Orville? Lumian’s curiosity peaked, prompting him to interrupt Ludwig.
target: “Dylan? Num nomen est archaei castri Loki? Et quid est Orville? Curiositas Luminiani culminate pervenit, impellens eum Ludwig interrumpere.”

source: “Apart from the name itself, is there any relevant knowledge?”
target: “Praeter ipsum nomen, num quaedam scientia pertinent?”

source: Ludwig seized the opportunity to take another bite of cake. After chewing and swallowing, he said, “No, but… these two terms seem to be connected. Orville should be the name of a place, and Dylan is the castle’s name.”
target: Ludwig occasionem ad alium morsum placentae arripuit. Manducato et deglutito, dixit, “Non, sed hi duo termini coniuncti videntur. Orville nomen loci esse debet, et Dylan castri nomen est.”

source: Connected… Name of a place… Castle Dylan is in Orville? Where is Orville?
target: Coniuncti… Nomen loci… Castrum Dylan in Orville est? Ubi est Orville?

source: Lumian turned to Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, realizing they were clueless, shaking their heads in ignorance.
target: Lumian ad Francam, Jennam, et Antonium versa, animadvertens eos nescios esse, et capita in ignorantia agitando.

source: After a moment of contemplation, Lumian spoke in a deep voice,
target: Post breve meditationis intervallum, Lumian voce profunda locutus est,

source: “Our next priority is to find information about Orville and Dylan through our respective channels.”
target: “Proximum nostrum propositum est invenire informationes de Orville et Dylan per vias nostras.”

source: Getting nods of agreement from Franca and the others, Lumian asked Ludwig again, “Anything else?”
target: Consensu Francae et ceterorum captus, Lumian iterum Ludovicum interrogavit, “Aliud quid?”

source: “His spirituality is quite abundant, and his quality isn’t bad. He doesn’t like hard liquor or drinking freely. He only drinks champagne and occasionally has coffee. He’s a loyal advocate of tea leaves. He’s healthy, has good bowel movement, and urinates normally. He hates the smell of the washroom…” Ludwig shared the information obtained from the half arm.
target: “Spiritualitas eius abundat, et natura eius non mala est. Non amat liquor durum neque libere bibit. Solum champagnam bibit et interdum caffeum sumit. Fidelis est fautor foliorum theae. Saluber est, bene motus intestinorum habet, et micturam regulariter facit. Odorem latrinae odit…” Ludwig haec notitia ex dimidio brachii communicavit.

source: Franca listened with keen interest, and just as Lumian was about to interject, Ludwig divulged another piece of valuable information:
target: Franca cum aviditate auscultavit, et iusto cum Lumian intervenire pararetur, Ludwig alteram pretiosam informationem divulgavit:

source: “He owns Castle Dylan, but he doesn’t reside there. He only returns occasionally. He’s not the sole proprietor yet. Many areas there aren’t accessible to him. Recently, he unlocked a room and acquired a dark-gold mask.
target: “Possidet Castrum Dylan, sed ibi non habitat. Solum aliquando revertitur. Nondum solus possessor est. Multae regiones illuc ei non adsunt. Nuper conclave aperuit et adeptus est larvam nigro-auream.

source: “That mask will grant him immense power, but once he wears it, he’ll face terrifying matters.”
target: Illa larva ei ingentem potentiam dabit, sed, cum eam induerit, res terribiles experietur.”

source: Could that dark-gold mask be a relic from the original owner of Castle Dylan? Perhaps a memento from the previous leader of the Secret Order? Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
target: Num illa larva nigro-aurea sit reliquia originalis possessoris Castri Dylan? Forsitan memento a priori ductore Ordine Secreto? Lumian cogitabundus caput nutavit.

source: To him, this information wasn’t particularly crucial as the dark-gold mask had already been handed over to Mr. K. Thus, he had no reason to be concerned about it.
target: Ei, haec informatio minime necessaria videbatur, cum larva nigro-aurea iam domino K tradita esset; ergo, nihil curandum habebat de ea.

source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony prepared to return to Trier after the Q&A session with Ludwig, having confirmed that they had gleaned all they could.
target: Franca, Jenna, et Antonius ad Trier redire praeparabantur post sessionem quaestionum et responsionum cum Ludwig, confirmato omnia percepta esse.

source: Of course, Lumian took responsibility for their return journey. Franca couldn’t bring herself to use one of the Seven-Stone Bracelets at the moment.
target: Certe, Lumian reditum eorum curavit; Franca se non potuit adhibere unam ex septem lapidum armillis in praesenti.

source: “By the way,” Lumian looked at Franca, pondering for a moment. “Contact the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and see if they’re willing to exchange information about the humanoid Sealed Artifact and its corresponding story. We’ll make efforts to facilitate this transaction.”
target: “Praeterea,” Lumian ad Francam aspexit, paulisper meditans, “Continge Ecclesiam Solis Aeterni Flammarum et vide si parati sint ad informationes de Artefacto Sigillato humanoideo atque eius historia commutanda. Conabimur hanc transactionem facilitare.”

source: Upon Bard’s mention that he was uncertain about his human status, Lumian realized his resemblance to the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
target: Cum Bardus diceret se de sua humana natura dubitare, Lumian animadvertit eum esse simile Artefacto Sigillato humanoideo.

source: However, Bard retained his rationality and clarity, possessing a relatively independent fate. Otherwise, he could be deemed a walking Grade 0 humanoid Sealed Artifact.
target: Attamen, Bardus rationem ac claritatem servavit, sortem suam relative independentem habens; alio modo, putaretur ambulare ut Artefactum Sigillatum humanoide gradus 0.

source: This sparked Lumian’s curiosity about the humanoid Sealed Artifact, wanting to uncover what had happened to her and why she had transformed in such a manner.
target: Hoc Luminiani curiositatem de Artefacto Sigillato humanoideo excitavit, eo quod quaerebat quid ei contigerat et cur ita mutata esset.

source: Franca nodded and instinctively said, “But, uh, that lady only mentioned the possibility of returning it, nothing definite.”
target: Franca caput nutavit instinctiveque dixit, “Sed, uh, illa femina solum de facultate eius redimenti locuta est, nihil certum.”

source: “We’re merely striving to facilitate the transaction. It’s not guaranteed either.” Lumian chuckled.
target: “Solum conamur transactionem faciliorem reddere. Quamquam non est id certum,” inquit Lumian subridens.

source: He quickly sent Franca, Jenna, and Anthony back to Trier Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative before entering Aquina Street.
target: Celeriter Francam, Jennam, et Antonium ad Trier Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative redire misit, antequam in Via Aquina intraret.

source: Strolling among the citizens still immersed in the afterglow of the celebration, he made his way towards Solow Motel.
target: Inter cives adhuc in luce celebrationis immersos ambulans, ad Solow Motel se contulit.

source: Half of the motel’s fifth floor had collapsed, and the fourth floor was severely damaged.
target: Dimidium tabulati quintae Solow Motel corruit, et tabulatum quartum graviter laesum erat.

source: Otta, the owner, observed the scene with sorrow and helplessness.
target: Otta, dominus, scaenam cum maerore et impotentia contemplatus est.

source: He wanted to cry, but the tears wouldn’t come.
target: Volebat flere, sed lacrimae non veniebant.

source: At a certain point, Noelia of the Fertility Order approached Louis Berry, the adventurer overseeing Solow Motel.
target: Ad certo puncto, Noelia ex Ordine Fertilitatis accessit ad Ludovicum Berry, adventorem qui Solow Motel curabat.

source: She spoke in a formal tone, “Your partner said you’d be responsible for the compensation.”
target: Ea, tono formali, dixit: “Socius tuus annuntiavit te responsalem esse de compensatione.”

source: Lumian retrieved 10,000 gold risot from his Traveler’s Bag and handed it to Noelia.
target: Lumian decem milia risot aureorum e sacco viatoris sui extraxit et tradidit Noeliae.

source: Noelia glanced at his black coin bag and sighed with emotion.
target: Noelia in sacculum nigrum nummorum eius aspexit et cum affectu suspiravit.

source: “That’s good stuff.”
target: “Optima res est.”

source: The combat nun then counted the compensation.
target: Deinde monialis bellica compensationem numeravit.

source: “10,000 risot? That’s enough to build two motels like this!”
target: “Decem milia risot? Satis est ad duas moteles huiusmodi extruendos!”

source: “How generous. Just as expected from an adventurer who recently bagged a bounty of 300,000 gold risot.”
target: “Quam liberalis. Sicut exspectatum a aventore, qui nuper praemium trecenta milia risot aureorum adeptus est!”

source: Lumian brushed off Noelia’s teasing and continued, “This is the reward from the Paco family’s commission.”
target: Lumian iocum Noeliae deiecerat atque procedens dixit, “Hoc est praemium ex commissione familiae Paco.”

source: “The Paco family…” Noelia fell silent.
target: “Familia Paco…” Noelia tacuit.

source: The Paco family’s matriarch, the current family head, and his wife—all perished in this conflict.
target: Matriarcha familiae Paco, caput familiae hodiernum, et uxor eius—omnes in hoc certamine perierunt.

source: Lumian pressed on, weaving through the crowd as if on a leisurely stroll.
target: Lumian procedebat, per turbam intertextus, quasi leniter ambulans.

source: In the dusk’s afterglow, he heard singing, seabirds chirping, and citizens animatedly discussing the past few days.
target: In crepusculo post splendorem, cantus audivit, aves marinas stridulas, et cives vehementer de proximis diebus disserentes.

source: “Did you see that?
target: “Vidistine id?

source: In the morning, seabirds came to pay their respects to the Governor of the Sea!”
target: Mane, aves marinas venerandi causa ad Praefectum Maris accesserunt!

source: “Is this year’s sea prayer ritual that successful?
target: “Num ritus orationis maris huius anni tam felix est?

source: “That’s right.
target: “Ita est.

source: Back then, many vines grew crazily.
target: Illo tempore, multae vites insaniter creverunt.

source: Many people fainted from joy.
target: Multi ex gaudio ceciderunt.

source: This is Earth Mother’s recognition of the sea prayer ritual!
target: Hoc est agnitio Matris Terrae ritus orationis maris!

source: “No, that’s not right. It represents a bumper harvest. It means this year’s fish harvest will fill ship after ship!”
target: “Minime, hoc non est verum. Id repraesentat messem copiosam; hoc ergo significat messem piscariae huius anni navem post navem replebit!”

source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

source: “Praise the Governor of the Sea!”
target: “Laudate Praefectum Maris!”

source: Though Lumian wasn’t privy to the Church of Earth Mother’s method to make citizens view the morning mysticism roundup as a miracle, he sensed joy and delight in everyone’s hearts.
target: Quamquam Lumian non versabatur in ratione Ecclesiae Matris Terrae qua cives mane mysticam colectionem ut miraculum haberent, tamen gaudium et delectationem in cordibus omnium sensit.

source: Leisurely, he thought, I wonder if the remaining committee members of the Fisheries Guild have finalized the choice for the fake Governor of the Sea.
target: Lente cogitans, miror num reliqui membra commissionis piscatoriae electionem falsi Praefecti Maris consummaverint.

source: Sure, the real Simon Guiaro is the top contender.
target: Certe, verus Simon Guiaro est optimus contenderentis.

source: However, it doesn’t matter who takes the role this year.
target: Attamen, nihil refert quis hanc partem hoc anno capiat.

source: The power leaked by the spaceship is now in my possession.
target: Potestas, quae a nave siderali effusa est, nunc in possessione mea est.

source: In the next year or even two, there won’t be frequent catastrophes in these waters.
target: In anno proximo vel etiam biennio, casus catastrophici in his aquis non frequenter occurrent.

source: The sea creatures will reproduce faster thanks to the ‘watering’…
target: Creaturae maris celerius proliferabuntur, propter irrigationem.

source: Heh heh, from a certain perspective, I’m the true Governor of the Sea—for just a week…
target: Heh heh, ex aliqua parte, verus Praefectus Maris sum—modo per hebdomadam…

source: In the midst of the lively parade and numerous street vendors, Lumian casually located a bar and ordered an undiluted Manzan and a large cup of locally brewed dark-gold malt beer.
target: Inter vivam pompam et plures mercatorum in viis, Lumian casualiter popinam invenit atque iussit Manzan non dilutum et magnum poculum cerevisiae obscuro-aureae localiter factae.

source: Placing the Manzan glass across from the small round table, he lifted his beer, clinking it.
target: Posuens vitrum Manzan trans mensam parvam rotundam, cerevisiam suam attollens, sonitum reddidit.

source: Then, he muttered with a smile, “Did you see that? Did you hear that? Their dance, their singing, and the sound of fish multiplying.
target: Tum subridens murmuravit, “Vidistine id? Audivistine id? Saltus eorum, cantus eorum, et sonus piscis multiplicantium.

source: “Isn’t this the future you desire?”
target: Nonne hoc est futurum quod desideras?

source: With that said, Lumian downed a mouthful of dark-gold beer.
target: Dictis his, Lumian poculum cervisiae obscuro-aureae deglutivit.
